eligibility: At least one validation split has strictly positive unrounded L3 minus L4 IoU at the same state dimension
stop: If neither state dimension is eligible, stop before formal training or held-out model evaluation
ranking: Equal split averages, weighted by configs/sdr004.json; when scores differ by at most 0.005 prefer dstate1
formal: All nine named groups across seeds 0/1/2, with L1/L2 at selected capacity and an additional L3/L4/L5 triplet at the alternate capacity; 768 updates and last checkpoint
verification: Capacity confirmation requires positive mean same-capacity L3 minus L4 and L3 minus L5 on fresh ID for the alternate capacity. Far recall and distractor margins apply against raster on each held-out family.
holdout: No trained predictions on a test split until the fixed-capacity formal matrix has completed
bootstrap: Pair maps across compared models and all seeds, resample map clusters within each split, recompute per-seed micro IoU and average the paired differences.
